title: Little Brother
plot_overview: A tightly controlled realtor’s picture-perfect life is disrupted when his chaotic younger brother suddenly returns. As their opposing personalities collide, the two must navigate embarrassing mishaps, family tension, and an unexpected bond that challenges the life he has carefully built.
will_you_like_this: You’ll enjoy this if you like light, family-flavored comedies with clashing personalities, goofy mishaps, and a warm tone; Not for you if you need originality, sharp surprises, or consistently big laughs.
review_summary: Pros: charming lead pairing; funny moments; easygoing tone | Cons: predictable story; uneven jokes; simple resolutions
